name: home-typed
js: (async()=>{const el=document.querySelector('textarea, input[type=text], input[type=search], input:not([type])');if(!el)return 'no input';const proto=el.tagName==='TEXTAREA'?HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype;Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto,'value').set.call(el,'Meghalaya with friends in December');el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));el.blur();return el.tagName+' '+el.placeholder})()
